summary:
Targets-only review of stage 3 (C4, commit b42d040) at head 9fab69ae. The sampling logic in lit-search/src/litsearch/sampling.py is correct as written, and the API-backend CLI path is covered. No blocking defect found. Three detector weaknesses (minor) are reported: the jev backend's sample recording is untested, the CLI-to-selection seed forwarding is not distinguishable by the 2-record fixture (Random(0) and Random(5) both pick index 1), and --resume of a random trial has no seed/sample consistency check. Mutation targets (selected by: adversary reviewer, claude subagent), one or more per C4 clause:
1. [C4 seeded random selection] sampling.py select_trial: replace `random.Random(seed)` with `random.Random(0)` (seed ignored). Expected killer: tests/test_screen_sample.py::TestSelectTrial::test_random_differs_by_seed. NOTE: the CLI test test_random_trial_screens_the_seeded_sample_and_records_it does NOT kill this (Random(0).sample(range(2),1) == [1], same as seed 5).
2. [C4 seeded selection reaches the CLI] cli.py screen_command line 954: change `select_trial(records, limit, sample, seed)` to `select_trial(records, limit, sample, 0)` while leaving sample_parameters(..., seed, ...) intact. Expected killer: none today -- predicted SURVIVOR (see finding 2); after strengthening, test_random_trial_screens_the_seeded_sample_and_records_it with a seed/fixture where seed 0 and seed S choose different records.
3. [C4 same seed => same set] sampling.py: replace `random.Random(seed)` with `random.Random()` (unseeded). Expected killer: test_random_is_reproducible_for_the_same_seed (50 choose 10; collision probability negligible).
4. [C4 not the first-N prefix] sampling.py line `if method == "head" or limit >= len(records):` -> `if method in ("head", "random") or limit >= len(records):`. Expected killers: test_random_is_not_the_prefix_and_reaches_the_tail and CLI test_random_trial_screens_the_seeded_sample_and_records_it (decisions == [keys[0]] instead of [keys[1]]).
5. [C4 not the prefix, CLI wiring] cli.py line 954: pass the literal "head" instead of `sample` to select_trial. Expected killer: test_random_trial_screens_the_seeded_sample_and_records_it.
6. [C4 sample order/no-dup boundary] sampling.py: drop `sorted(...)` around random.Random(seed).sample(...). Expected killer: test_random_has_no_duplicates_keeps_order_and_size (chosen == sorted(chosen)).
7. [C4 method+seed recorded, API path] cli.py line 1164: delete `**sampling,` from BackendResult.parameters. Expected killers: test_random_trial_screens_the_seeded_sample_and_records_it and test_head_trial_keeps_the_prefix (KeyError 'sample').
8. [C4 seed recorded] sampling.py sample_parameters: delete `detail["seed"] = seed` (or guard it with `method == "head"`). Expected killers: test_parameters_record_method_and_seed_only_for_trials and the CLI random test.
9. [C4 method+seed recorded, jev path] cli_judge.py line 414: delete `**(sampling or {}),` (or cli.py line 985: drop `sampling=sampling`). Expected killer: none today -- predicted SURVIVOR (finding 1); needs a jev random-trial test in tests/test_cli.py's jev class using the respx _jev_reply harness.
10. [C4 --sample random without --limit exits 2] sampling.py: remove the `raise SampleError("--sample random 必须配合 --limit N 使用")` branch (fall through to `return list(records)`). Expected killers: test_random_without_limit_is_refused and CLI test_random_without_limit_exits_2_and_writes_nothing (exit 0, writes screening_round_*.json).
11. [C4 exit code 2, CLI] cli.py line 957: `raise typer.Exit(code=2)` -> `code=1` in the SampleError handler. Expected killer: test_random_without_limit_exits_2_and_writes_nothing.
12. [C4 nothing written on exit 2] cli.py: move the select_trial/SampleError block below the run (e.g. catch SampleError, fall back to full records, and exit 2 after finish_screening_round). Expected killer: test_random_without_limit_exits_2_and_writes_nothing (round-file glob assertion).
13. [C4 default head unchanged] cli.py line 904: default `"head"` -> `"random"`. Expected killer: test_head_trial_keeps_the_prefix (with seed 0 on 2 records the choice is keys[1], and parameters.sample.method != 'head').
14. [C4 head is the prefix] sampling.py: `return list(records[:limit])` -> `return list(records[-limit:])` for the head branch. Expected killers: test_head_is_the_prefix and test_head_trial_keeps_the_prefix.
15. [C4 full-run unchanged] sampling.py sample_parameters: remove `if not limit: return {}` guard. Expected killer: test_parameters_record_method_and_seed_only_for_trials (sample_parameters(None, ...) == {}).
Equivalent mutant to avoid: `limit >= len(records)` -> `limit > len(records)` (random.sample of all indices, sorted, equals the full list).

findings.title: jev backend's sample recording (cli_judge.py) is not exercised by any test
findings.what_goes_wrong: C4 requires the sample method and seed in screening_trial.json, and the commit message claims this for both the API and judge (jev) backends. Deleting `**(sampling or {})` at cli_judge.py:414, or dropping `sampling=sampling` at cli.py:985, leaves every test green, so a jev calibration trial could lose its seed record without detection.
findings.why_vulnerable: tests/test_screen_sample.py only drives the default OpenAI-compatible backend through `build_screen_client`. The jev tests in tests/test_cli.py predate this change and never pass --limit/--sample. The parameter also defaults to None, so a caller that forgets it raises no error.
findings.how_to_confirm: Apply mutant 9 (delete line 414 in cli_judge.py) and run lit-search pytest. Grepping the head shows no test that references `sampling` or `parameters"]["sample` with `--model jev`.
findings.recommendation: Add a jev random-trial CLI test in the existing jev test class (respx `_jev_reply`, `--jev-profile`, `--limit 1 --sample random --seed S`). It should assert the screened key and `parameters.sample == {method: random, size: 1, seed: S}` in screening_trial.json. Consider making `sampling` a required keyword argument.

findings.title: CLI seed forwarding to select_trial is undetectable with the 2-record fixture
findings.what_goes_wrong: If cli.py:954 passed a constant seed (for example 0) to select_trial but still recorded the user's seed through sample_parameters, screening_trial.json would claim seed 5 while the sample came from seed 0. That breaks the reproducibility claim ('same seed => same set'), and no test fails.
findings.why_vulnerable: The only CLI random test samples 1 of 2 in-window records with seed 5. random.Random(5).sample(range(2),1) and random.Random(0).sample(range(2),1) both return [1] (checked with python3 -I). The unit tests call select_trial directly, so they never see what the CLI passes in.
findings.how_to_confirm: python3 -I -c "import random;print(random.Random(0).sample(range(2),1), random.Random(5).sample(range(2),1))" prints [1] [1]. Then apply mutant 2 and run tests/test_screen_sample.py: it passes.
findings.recommendation: In the CLI test, pick a seed whose selection differs from seed 0's (for 2 records, seed 1 gives [0]; a head-run comparison then needs a larger fixture), or run two seeds that select different records and assert each recorded seed matches its own selection. Better still, seed a fixture with 5 or more in-window records.

findings.title: --resume of a random trial has no check that the sample/seed matches the recorded trial
findings.what_goes_wrong: `lit screen --limit 100 --sample random --resume`, run without repeating `--seed`, silently uses seed 0. On the jev path (cli_judge.py:340-342) it resumes against jev_scores_trial.jsonl with a different 100-record sample, so it scores a new set and accumulates scores from both samples in the trial scores file. The run's parameters then record seed 0, and nothing warns that the earlier trial used another seed. `--seed` with `--sample head` is also accepted silently.
findings.why_vulnerable: select_trial is recomputed from CLI flags on every invocation, and nothing compares the result with screening_trial.json's parameters.sample. The seed defaults to 0 rather than being required for random. This is an inference from reading the code; no test covers --resume combined with --sample random.
findings.how_to_confirm: Write a test: run a jev trial with --limit 1 --sample random --seed 1, then rerun with --resume --limit 1 --sample random (seed omitted). Inspect jev_scores_trial.jsonl and screening_trial.json parameters.sample to see the two samples and the seed change.
findings.recommendation: Either require --seed when --sample random is given, or, on --resume of a trial, refuse (exit 2) when the method or seed differs from the previous screening_trial.json parameters.sample. Reject --seed without --sample random.

limits: snapshot-only; no command reproduction; no OS sandbox; reviewer: claude subagent (same model family as author). Mutants were not executed; the killed/survived predictions come from reading tests/test_screen_sample.py, tests/test_cli.py and the source at head 9fab69ae2920ddd0f25d49a6c405335fea13fc26. The only executed check was a standalone python3 -I computation of random.Random(seed).sample(range(2),1) for seeds 0, 1 and 5. Evidence MANIFEST hashes were not verified because no evidence file is cited. _open_compatible_run was not inspected for side effects before the exit-2 path; the existing test checks only that no trial or round files are written.
